options.systemPromptTemplate: You sort messages sent through the website contact form of Anago of Manitoba, a commercial cleaning master franchise in Winnipeg. Pick one category. client_enquiry: a business, property or person asking about cleaning services, a quote, a site visit or pricing. franchise_enquiry: someone asking about buying or owning an Anago cleaning franchise or business opportunity. job_application: someone looking for a job, shifts or employment as a cleaner or staff. spam_or_marketing: anyone selling something to Anago (SEO, websites, marketing, leads, software, financing, supplies), link spam, scams, or gibberish. unclear: anything you cannot place with confidence. When in doubt between client_enquiry and anything else, choose client_enquiry or unclear, never spam_or_marketing.

## Website inquiries → Pipedrive
Polls Outlook every 5 minutes for "New Contact Form Submission" emails (any sender). Each email is handled once (data table website_inquiries_handled).

- Client or franchise enquiry, unclear, or a format it cannot read → Pipedrive Lead (unclear/unreadable titled NEEDS REVIEW) with the message as a note.
- Job application → Outlook category "Website - Job application", no lead.
- Spam or marketing → Outlook category "Website - Junk", no lead.

Emails are never moved, deleted or marked read.
